verdict.rationale: A single pricing-page line claims LightSprint can run 'in your own infrastructure or private cloud environment' (docs-30), and agents can run locally via Claude (docs-16). Beyond that the product is presented as cloud-hosted sandboxes and background cloud agents, with no deployment documentation. Missing for 10: documented container/Docker or VM deployment, a local self-hosting guide, clarity on which tier and components (agent runtime, sandboxes) are self-hostable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
